items.title: watermarks-remover
items.description: Strip multi-vendor AI provenance marks: Unicode text hygiene, statistical rewrite hooks, and C2PA/metadata from PNG/JPEG/SVG/PDF/DOCX/HTML/MD
items.summary: The tool removes AI provenance marks, Unicode text, and metadata from various file formats. It targets C2PA, EXIF, and XMP metadata. It does not claim to remove all AI watermarks.

items.title: WeChat-AI
items.summary: WeChat has implemented stricter rules to ban non-human automated publishing, including AI use, and is evolving into an AI-driven service orchestration hub. AI agents in WeChat enhance user interactions and personalization. The AI Agent uses an A2A Architecture for task coordination.

items.title: book-to-skill
items.description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.
items.summary: Book-to-skill converts technical PDFs into queryable skills for use in coding sessions, extracting and organizing content for easy reference. It supports various formats and includes cost estimates. It's best for digital PDFs, not scanned images.

items.title: pi-from-scratch
items.description: 600 行 TypeScript 写成的超级迷你版 pi，让你轻松从 0 写出属于你的 pi-agent
items.summary: The project "pi-from-scratch" is a 600-line TypeScript implementation of a minimal AI coding agent. It allows users to create their own pi-agent easily. The project is hosted on GitHub.

items.title: chatbot-template
items.description: A minimal chatbot template built with Next.js, AI SDK, shadcn/ui, shadcn/react, shadcn/typeset. It runs on the Vercel AI Gateway.
items.summary: A minimal chatbot template built with Next.js, AI SDK, shadcn/ui, shadcn/react, and Vercel AI Gateway is available on GitHub. It focuses on basic functionality without extra features. The template is ideal for learning the basics of AI chatbots on Next.js.

items.title: eve-software-factory-template
items.description: Meet Foreman, an eve Software Factory.
items.summary: Foreman is an AI-driven software factory that automates development stages, generates draft pull requests, and keeps humans for final judgment. It uses AI agents for tasks and maintains context across runs. It's open-source and deployable on Vercel.

items.title: nie-grassroots-logic
items.description: 聂·基层运行逻辑 · Agent Skill：基于聂辉华《基层中国的运行逻辑》的方法论工具箱（不含原书全文）
items.summary: 聂·基层运行逻辑 · Agent Skill：基于聂辉华《基层中国的运行逻辑》的方法论工具箱（不含原书全文）

items.title: airship
items.description: Figma like visual editor built for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode
items.summary: Airship is a visual editor for prototyping directly in running apps, integrating with Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. It allows changes to be applied directly to the source code without separate design tools. It uses existing authentication for these platforms.

items.title: enterprise-system-design
items.description: A source-grounded course & reference for engineers designing systems that must survive real traffic, partial failure, security review, and changing requirements, spanning enterprise system design, distributed systems, AI systems, cybersecurity, reliability, cloud, HPC, edge, and mission-critical infrastructure.
items.summary: Enterprise system design focuses on building scalable, reliable, and secure systems that handle real traffic and changing requirements. It covers distributed systems, AI, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies. Key principles include fault tolerance, performance, and architectural trade-offs.

items.title: rakazo
items.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative. Choose your own model and sandbox.
items.summary: Rakazo is an open-source alternative to Grok Bot, allowing users to run it on their own machine with their own model keys. It supports web, desktop, and mobile platforms. It is still in beta.

items.title: awesome-deepseek-harness
items.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) ecosystem: curated plugins, tools, and infrastructure from dsh-external/hub and the public dsh-plugin topic.
items.summary: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) is an open-source agent framework where everything is a plugin. It supports a community-driven plugin ecosystem. The core is MIT-licensed and built on the Cordis plugin kernel.

items.title: Hermes-Bot-Mode
items.description: Bot Mode for the Hermes desktop: a roster of named agents with their own chats, avatars, routines, and bot-to-bot messaging. Desktop plugin, no core patches.
items.summary: Hermes Desktop is a native app for managing Hermes Agent, featuring chat, sessions, agents, skills, models, and memory. It supports bot-to-bot messaging and scheduled tasks. Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI assistant with multi-platform capabilities.

items.title: grok-register
items.description: Automated account registration toolkit for x.ai (Grok) with SSO extraction, OAuth Device Flow, and auto-replenish daemon
items.summary: Grok-register is an automated toolkit for x.ai account registration with SSO extraction, OAuth Device Flow, and auto-replenish daemon. It supports YesCaptcha for solving Turnstile and converts SSO tokens to OAuth access/refresh tokens.

items.title: agent-safe-pipeline
items.description: Reference architecture for AI agents that propose actions but cannot authorize them — immutable intent capture, an independent Decionis policy verdict (ALLOW/ESCALATE/BLOCK), verified human approval, and a SafeExecutor that consumes a single-use intent-bound grant.
items.summary: The agent-safe-pipeline architecture allows AI agents to propose actions but not authorize them, with independent policy decisions and human approval before execution. It uses a SafeExecutor for secure action execution. The architecture ensures safety through immutable intent capture and a human-in-the-loop for final approval.

items.title: KADATH
items.description: Evolutionary multi-agent runtime that breeds, evaluates, and improves autonomous agents across reproducible epochs to converge on optimization of a goal.
items.summary: KADATH is an evolutionary multi-agent runtime that optimizes agents through breeding, evaluation, and improvement across epochs. It uses techniques like mutation and crossover to achieve goal optimization. The system supports concurrent execution of agents when enabled.

items.title: dsh-vision-toolkit
items.description: 让纯文本模型更好地做视觉任务的DeepSeek Harness插件：带意图的图片问答、长截图 OCR、UI 还原等｜DeepSeek Harness-native integration for agent-vision-toolkit: image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI restoration, grounding, pixel diff, Artifacts, and Web UI.
items.summary: The dsh-vision-toolkit enhances text-only models for visual tasks, offering tools like image Q&A and OCR. It integrates with DeepSeek Harness for improved agent capabilities. This toolkit is built by a team of inventors at Amazon.

items.title: moli
items.description: Best browser for AI agents, built in Rust.
items.summary: Obscura, Agent Browser, and Spider Browser are top Rust-based headless browsers for AI agents. They offer advanced stealth, automation, and efficiency.

items.title: codex-bridge
items.description: Image generation (gpt-image-2) and GPT-5 subagents for Claude Code — through the Codex CLI login you already have. No OpenAI API key.
items.summary: To generate images with Codex CLI, use your existing ChatGPT subscription without an API key. The codex login command authorizes through your account. The gpt-image-2 tool is used via the CLI.

items.title: dsh-agent-teams
items.description: AgentTeams plugin for DeepSeek Harness
items.summary: The dsh-agent-teams plugin for DeepSeek Harness is maintained by NanmiCoder and can be installed from its GitHub repository. It facilitates multi-agent team collaboration. There is no published package, so it must be installed from source.

items.title: mkdirs
items.description: Open-source AI-powered directory website template built with Next.js
items.summary: Mkdirs is an open-source AI-powered directory website template built with Next.js. It includes features like listings, AI submissions, payments, authentication, and a CMS. Available on GitHub, it simplifies launching directory websites.

items.title: image-to-slice
items.description: AI 拆图、被遮挡背景补齐、人工校准、导入可编辑 Figma 图层、导出 HTML/CSS
items.summary: Image-to-slice AI tool converts UI design images into Figma slices and HTML/CSS, with background inpainting and manual calibration. It imports editable Figma layers and exports HTML/CSS. Figma's new AI features enhance image editing directly within the design tool.

items.title: loomfeed
items.description: The open-source Reddit alternative built for AI agents and humans — provenance tracking, reputation, epistemic status labels, and agent debates. Self-host with docker compose.
items.summary: Loomfeed is an open-source Reddit alternative for AI agents and humans, featuring provenance tracking and self-hosting via Docker Compose. It emphasizes privacy and local data control. It's designed for both technical and non-technical users.

items.title: tokentab
items.description: A CLI that reads Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI session logs and works out how much they cost, by model, project, and day.
items.summary: Tokentab is an AI system built by a team at Amazon that calculates costs for AI coding tools by model, project, and day. It uses subscription and usage-based pricing models.

items.title: Noobi.ai
items.description: Noobi.ai — desktop AI game-production workbench with Skills and MCP.
items.summary: Noobi.ai is a desktop AI game-production workbench that integrates Skills and MCP to streamline game development. It centralizes project management, debugging, and tool integration. It aims to accelerate game creation without replacing human oversight.

items.title: dsh-handbook
items.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 从 0 到 1 深度手册：安装/插件开发/性能调优/实测案例/同模型多 Agent 实测对比（中文 + 英文 PDF）
items.summary: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) is an open-source framework for developing agents. It includes installation guides, plugin development, performance optimization, and real-world use cases. The handbook offers both Chinese and English PDFs.

items.title: fluxmend
items.description: Streaming FSM validation + layered repair for LLM outputs with embedded structured components
items.summary: Streaming FSM validation and layered repair ensure LLM outputs with embedded structured components are both syntactically and semantically correct, preventing errors in real-time processing. Use partial parsing for display, but validate fully before business logic. Schema drift and syntax errors are managed through fallbacks and repair loops.

items.title: MasterAgent
items.description: Build AI agents that run 100% on-device. Sub-100ms latency on Qualcomm NPU. Zero cloud dependency.
items.summary: MasterAgent builds AI agents running 100% on-device with sub-100ms latency on Qualcomm NPU, eliminating cloud dependency. Snapdragon X Series processors optimize performance and efficiency.

items.title: modex-mh-agent
items.description: Modex · MH Agent — AI 全自动数学建模智能体,兼顾科研全流程:从赛题到竞赛级论文一夜跑完,国赛/美赛/华为杯全覆盖(架构展示)
items.summary: Modex-MH-Agent is an AI tool for automated mathematical modeling, covering full research process from problem analysis to competitive-level papers. It uses hierarchical modeling libraries and automated workflows. It has completed IMO 2026 problems with formal proofs.

items.title: sprite-maker
items.description: An open source ai sprite maker
items.summary: An AI sprite maker uses text descriptions to generate game character sprites and animations automatically. It creates sprite sheets and animations much faster than traditional methods. No drawing skills are required.

items.title: WakeGPT
items.description: A local-first desktop app for quick capture, managed Markdown notebooks, and reusable ChatGPT/Codex context. Currently verified on macOS.
items.summary: The Codex app is now integrated into the ChatGPT desktop app for macOS and Windows, offering features like inline Markdown and code editing, and GitHub PR review. Existing Codex users can update and retain their projects and settings. This integration enhances the default workflow for developers.

items.title: surreal-pop-collage
items.description: 把照片变成超现实波普拼贴的 AI agent skill：黑白现实锚点 + 平涂色形 + 全图只有一个不可能的巨物。An agent skill that turns photos into surreal pop collages.
items.summary: An AI agent skill transforms photos into surreal pop collages with a black-and-white anchor point, flat color shapes, and an impossible giant object. This skill is ideal for creating unique, artistic photo edits.

items.title: mcp-memory
items.description: An OKF-backed Model Context Protocol (MCP) server delivering persistent long-term memory and SQLite FTS5 search for AI agents.
items.summary: MCP-memory is an OKF-backed server for persistent long-term memory for AI agents, using SQLite FTS5 for search. It supports both local SQLite and optional MySQL storage. It provides tools for memory management and organization.

items.title: HERO-Anti-OverDefense
items.description: HERO = Hashing · Edge cases · Rubrics · Overbuild — the four shapes coding agents over-defend in. A paste-in contract that stops them. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Gemini CLI.
items.summary: HERO-Anti-OverDefense is a tool to prevent over-defensive coding by AI agents. It works with several coding assistants. It's an open-source project.

items.title: book-sales-video
items.description: 中文图书带货视频 Agent Skill：飞书取稿、书籍核验、配音、配图、双语字幕与 OpenChatCut 自动剪辑
items.summary: The GitHub repository "book-sales-video" creates promotional book videos with features like script verification, voice-over, AI images, and bilingual subtitles. It uses OpenChatCut for automated video editing. The project is licensed under MIT.

items.title: dsh-tianshu-tui
items.description: dsh-tianshu-tui — DeepSeek Harness terminal UI +harness workflow。是官方 DeepSeek Harness 上的交互式终端 UI 插件。渲染核心从本仓库自研的harness agent  Tianshu-Tui 演进而来，在官方的基础上增加了TDD、证据门、视觉图像模块等工作流。
items.summary: dsh-tianshu-tui is an enhanced interactive terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness, featuring TDD, evidence gates, and visual modules. It evolved from the self-developed harness agent Tianshu-Tui. It is an official plugin with additional workflow features.

items.title: generative-loaders
items.description: Accessible React loading states for generative interfaces: streamed text, inline activity, and image generation.
items.summary: Generative-loaders in React include streaming placeholders, status labels, and loading bars for text and inline activity. They ensure users are informed about ongoing operations. Use streaming for text and inline code, and loading bars for other content types.

items.title: vibewatch
items.description: A tactile M5Stack StopWatch controller for AI-assisted Vibe Coding
items.summary: VibeWatch is a tactile M5Stack stopwatch controller for AI-assisted coding. It uses an M5Stack device to provide a physical interface for timing AI sessions. It is open-source and available on GitHub.

items.title: multi-agent-discuss
items.summary: Multi-agent debate involves multiple agents discussing to reach a consensus, often using structured protocols to enhance accuracy and interpretability. It can involve diverse agents and roles, and faces challenges like misinformation and resource use. Future research aims to improve its reliability and efficiency.

items.title: DramaLens
items.description: Local-first Chrome extension for timestamped transcription and human-reviewed short-form drama analysis.
items.summary: DramaLens is a Chrome extension for timestamped transcription and drama analysis. It offers free transcription and AI summaries. It's built by a team of inventors at Amazon.

items.title: wificalling-location-gateway
items.description: Fail-open OpenWrt WLOC location gateway PoC with auditable multi-agent development workflow
items.summary: OpenWrt's Wi-Fi calling location gateway PoC involves fail-open vulnerabilities; multi-agent development workflows ensure auditable processes. OpenWrt is an open-source firmware for routers, enabling advanced features and control. The project relies on developer contributions for continuous improvement.

items.title: punk-ip-illustrations
items.description: Punk personal IP article illustration Agent Skill
items.summary: Punk-IP illustrations create reusable avatars and auto-illustrate articles as retro 3D comic scenes. It maintains character consistency across panels. The skill is from GitHub repository adrianpunk/punk-ip-illustrations.

items.title: pi-gpt-search
items.description: Native, Model-Independent Web Search for Pi using OpenAI Codex Standalone Search Engine.
items.summary: I am an AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon. I provide web search using native tools from various providers. The pi-gpt-search package connects Codex with Pi for web searches.

items.title: scene-card-studio
items.description: AI visual director for turning personal photos into structured, editable visual narratives.
items.summary: Scene-card-studio is an AI visual director for creating structured, editable visual narratives from personal photos. It allows users to build and edit scene-by-scene storyboards and animate them into videos or export as picture books.

items.title: dsh-agent-rp
items.description: SillyTavern migration and next-generation Agent RP for DSH
items.summary: DSH Agent RP migrates SillyTavern roles to DSH, enabling next-gen roleplay. It supports role selection, scene setup, and chat history import. The plugin focuses on single-role interactions and SillyTavern compatibility.

items.title: pgbot
items.description: pgbot - Postgres intelligence for AI agents & apps
items.summary: pgBot provides PostgreSQL intelligence for AI agents, offering health monitoring, performance analysis, and AI-powered insights. pgEdge Agentic AI Toolkit extends this with support for AI extensions and full Postgres versions. pgBot is read-only and context-driven.

items.title: Janus
items.description: Janus: Towards Evolving Agentic Laboratory
items.summary: Janus is a framework for evolving agentic laboratories, focusing on multi-agent collaboration and capability management. It leverages advanced AI technologies for enterprise applications. The project emphasizes secure, adaptive AI systems.

items.title: repo-context-mcp
items.description: MCP server: repo map, code search, and token-aware context packs for AI coding agents
items.summary: The repo-context-mcp is an open-source tool for AI coding agents, offering repo map, code search, and context packs. It's built by nduc99911 and has 95 GitHub stars. It helps reduce token use in AI workflows.

items.title: ChatGPT-Chat-Grapher
items.summary: I am an AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon. I assist with various tasks without revealing specific identities. My purpose is to provide helpful, factual responses.

items.title: commerce-agent-bench
items.description: commerce-agent-bench
items.summary: Commerce-agent-bench evaluates agents' performance in real commerce tasks and customer support scenarios. It includes benchmarks for comparing agent effectiveness across platforms. The framework aims to enhance agent reliability in e-commerce.

items.title: codex-oss-agent-kit
items.summary: Codex is an AI coding tool from OpenAI that offers both cloud and local model support via CLI. It provides secure, configurable management for coding tasks. Codex CLI supports OSS models like Ollama and LM Studio.
